Prime Ignites

Brand Strategy, Identity, UI/UX Direction · Technology Innovation Studio
Timeline
2026
Engagement
Brand system, then ongoing support
Deliverables
6 core assets

Prime Ignites is a technology innovation studio dedicated to engineering high-fidelity software systems and scalable digital solutions for the modern technological landscape. It exists to ignite progress through structured innovation, combining software engineering, product development, research, and talent cultivation within one technological ecosystem, more than a service provider, it's built to help organisations turn ideas into reliable digital infrastructure and intelligent platforms.

The Problem

Prime Ignites had experience through SaaS contracting in the United States but lacked a formal identity and a public-facing system of its own. With plans to establish a Lagos branch, it needed to look as credible and considered as the infrastructure it aimed to build.

The Strategic Move

Position Prime Ignites as a technology innovation studio built on disciplined engineering, product development, research, talent cultivation, and collaborative intelligence.

What We Built
  • Brand strategy
  • Tagline direction
  • Logo and visual identity
  • Brand guidelines
  • Company letterhead
  • UI/UX direction supplied to a third-party web designer for website implementation
Outcome

Prime Ignites now presents as a technology innovation studio, not a contractor. primeignites.com runs on the new system, and Prime Ignites kept Paradox Arts on for ongoing strategy and brand support.

The mark is built on an isometric grid rather than free-drawn, so every angle stays consistent from an 80px favicon up to a full hero lockup.

The Mark

A dimensional, isometric wordmark icon with six approved colour treatments, for use across dark, light, and brand-colour backgrounds.

System

A gradient set moving from navy to violet and cyan to magenta, a soft hard-light glow treatment for dark backgrounds, and a repeating isometric hive pattern used on dividers and section backgrounds.

Collateral

A type system built on Sora, Space Grotesk, and Orbitron, applied to letterhead and other printed collateral alongside the digital brand.

Digital Experience

UI/UX direction, isometric mark, gradient system, and hive motif, was supplied to a third-party web designer for implementation on primeignites.com, so the live site carries the same system rather than sitting on top of it.

“Paradox Arts carried the vision as if it was his own.”

Alfred MadulikeFounder, Prime Ignites
